items.title: Screenshots
items.why: The Print Screen key and the Screenshot app.

items.title: Desktop cube and extra widgets
items.why: Adds the 3D desktop cube (Settings > Personalization > Desktop effects) and more widgets for the taskbar and desktop.

items.title: Intel video acceleration
items.why: Smoother video and less battery use on Intel graphics.

items.title: Choose the graphics chip
items.why: Lets you run a program on the stronger graphics chip of a laptop that has two.
